integrity: The proof is analytical; the bundled checker verifies exact finite symbolic identities and finite diagnostic orbits. Finite sampling is not used to establish infinite-orbit statements. Source literature is attributed without assigning ownership of the new statement to the sources.
scientific_limitations: Exact entire-family admissibility is limited to the specified marked three-bisection word, with arbitrary longest-edge ties. Forbidden-block frequency is for formal, still physical returns at 0<q<=2 after possible invalid choices; it is not a density of legal LEB trajectories. The sharp volume bound holds at marked block boundaries, not all intermediate phases. Equivalent earlier formulations remain a bibliographic risk; no independent expert audit has been performed.
title: Sharp admissible ellipse and square-root obstruction frequency for tetrahedral longest-edge bisection
